data.one_liner: An animating curved shape bottom navigation bar with item labels.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customized bottom navigation bar widget with an animated curved shape for the selected item. Supports custom colors, animations, icons, and text labels for each navigation item.
use_when: You want a modern curved bottom navigation bar with labels.
You need custom animations and styling for bottom bar item switching.
avoid_when: You need standard Material 3 NavigationBar or CupertinoTabBar behavior.
You are using a navigation paradigm that does not fit bottom bars.
strengths: Easy to implement with a clean declarative API.
Supports labels alongside the original curved animation effect.
Allows programmatic page and index control via GlobalKey.
weaknesses: Limited to a specific curved layout design style.
May not conform strictly to standard Material Design guidelines depending on the version.
